text: OI! LISTEN UP! I just got knocked back on a one-bedroom shoebox in Footscray by SEVENTY-TWO other blokes, and one of 'em offered SIX MONTHS rent up front IN CASH! Absolute STREWTH!
action: slams both palms on the desk, knocking his headphones sideways, then jabs a finger straight down the barrel of the mic

text: But here's the kicker, mate — I've cracked it. I've found the ONE loophole that gets a bloke on the property ladder in this country, and I'm tellin' ya at the end of this ep. Game changer.
action: leans into the mic conspiratorially, taps his temple twice, then shadow-boxes a quick one-two at the air

text: Yeah, nah. Seventy-two blokes. Mate, I put in for a granny flat in Blacktown and the agent laughed at me. Down the phone. Like a dry little wheeze. Reckon he's cactus too, honestly.
action: blinks slowly, takes a long sip from his stubby holder, sets it down with a soft clunk and adjusts his headphones one-handed

text: Which is WHY this ep is brought to ya by BOOMER'S BOOT-SCOOT BOND BUSTER! Two hundred bucks and I turn up to your rental inspection, shirt OFF, flexin' at the agent till he signs outta pure fear! No wuckas!
action: stands up so fast his chair rolls back, rips at his shirt collar and flexes a double bicep over the desk while Kev leans away from him

text: Ground control to Boomer. That's not a sponsor, that's a restraining order with a logo. Also mate, if anyone real wants to give us money... we are flat out like a lizard drinkin'. We'd take a pie voucher.
action: deadpan straight down the lens, gum leaf hanging from the corner of his mouth, gives the mic one tiny apologetic pat

text: Fair dinkum though, Kev! Me old man bought a four-bedder in Brissy on a POSTIE'S WAGE! One wage! And a Kingswood in the driveway! What happened to this country?!
action: throws both arms wide in genuine debater's disbelief, then wipes sweat off his brow with his forearm and leans back in

text: What happened is your old man's four-bedder is now worth one-point-nine mill and he calls it a 'starter home'. He's the villain, mate. Your dad's the crisis.
action: shrugs one shoulder in slow motion, gestures loosely at Boomer with the stubby holder, then goes back to chewing

text: So HERE'S the loophole, right — ya move back in with the olds, ya charge 'em RENT for the emotional support, and ya wait for the inheritan— oh. Oh no.
action: lights up ecstatically, gestures like a magician revealing the trick, then his face collapses and both arms drop dead to the desk
